userMessage: How do I turn my HTML into real video?
answer1: You do not need an editor. Halcyon renders the HTML you already write into deterministic, pixel-perfect video.
answer3: What you get out of the box:
bullet1: A catalog of motion primitives you install and own
bullet2: GSAP timelines that seek to any frame
bullet3: 4K renders from a single CLI command
ecSub: Open-source video rendering — write HTML, ship pixel-perfect video.
